title: Tuesday at Grandma's
setting: Grandparents' small house: a little kitchen and a garden behind it.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Grandpa
characters.look: Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses

characters.name: Grandma
characters.look: Grandma, an old woman with gray hair in a bun and a red apron

sentences.en: Ben visits his grandparents every Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 本每个星期二早上都去看望祖父母。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt rings the doorbell of a small house in the morning sun; Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses and Grandma, an old woman with gray hair in a bun and a red apron open the door with smiles.

sentences.en: Grandpa drinks black coffee in the little kitchen.
sentences.zh: 爷爷在小厨房里喝黑咖啡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses sits in a small cosy kitchen holding a cup of black coffee.

sentences.en: Ben loves the smell of the coffee.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt closes his eyes and sniffs happily near Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses's steaming coffee cup.

sentences.en: It is cold outside, but Ben wants to play.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt presses his face to the kitchen window; outside the garden is frosty and the trees are bare.

sentences.en: He puts on warm trousers and his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他穿上暖和的裤子和鞋子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt sits on the floor by the door, pulling on thick trousers, a pair of shoes beside him.

sentences.en: Grandma opens the wide garden gate for him.
sentences.zh: 奶奶为他打开宽大的花园门。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandma, an old woman with gray hair in a bun and a red apron swings open a wide wooden garden gate while Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt runs out, frosty grass beyond.

sentences.en: Later, they eat pasta and sweet apple cake.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们吃意大利面和甜甜的苹果蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt, Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses and Grandma, an old woman with gray hair in a bun and a red apron sit at the kitchen table with plates of pasta and an apple cake.

sentences.en: They all agree that nothing is better than pasta.
sentences.zh: 他们都同意，没有什么比意大利面更好吃了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy of six with short brown hair and a blue shirt, Grandpa, an old man with white hair and round glasses and Grandma, an old woman with gray hair in a bun and a red apron nod and smile at each other over empty pasta plates.
